nodes.name: Nanodroplet-mediated Electrodeposition of HEMG-NP
nodes.procedure: Co-Fe-La-Ni-Pt-based high-entropy metallic glass nanoparticles (CoFeLaNiPt HEMG-NP) by nanodroplet-mediated electrodeposition. The water nanodroplets containing metal salt precursors are suspended in dichloroethane with the assistance of tetrabutylammonium perchlorate surfactant. CoFeLaNiPt HEMG-NP is obtained by an electro-shock of 100 ms.
nodes.source_text: Glasscott et al. have synthesized Co-Fe-La-Ni-Pt-based high-entropy metallic glass nanoparticles (CoFeLaNiPt HEMG-NP) by nanodroplet-mediated electrodeposition... CoFeLaNiPt HEMG-NP (diameter < 500 nm) is obtained by an electro-shock of 100 ms.
